Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results from the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer had successfully retrieved official Cambridge pages confirming the "Adam Smith Prize" is awarded by the Adam Smith Prize Endowment Fund within the Faculty of Economics at the University of Cambridge. However, the Planner ignored these correct findings and instead hallucinated a connection to "Treasury Today" and "Adam Smith Awards" (which are corporate treasury awards, not named after Adam Smith the author of The Wealth of Nations). This led to a completely wrong final answer (Treasury Today) instead of the correct one (University of Cambridge).
